==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|lykewise}}, {{m|enm|lykewyse}}, {{m|enm|lyke wyse}}, {{m|enm|lijk wise}}, a shortened form of {{der|en|enm|in lik wise|t={{m|en|in like wise}}}}; equivalent to {{suffix|en|like|wise}}. Compare with {{m|en|otherwise}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈlaɪkˌwaɪz/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-likewise.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|like|wise}}

===Adverb===
{{en-adv|-}}

# {{lb|en|manner}} In a [[similar]] [[manner]].
#: {{syn|en|thuswise#Adverb}}
#: {{ant|en|otherwise#Adverb}}
#: {{ux|en|[[public transportation|Public transportation]] is virtually inaccessible in this country; '''likewise''', its hospitals are also not very [[user-friendly]].}}
#: {{ux|en|Come at six, and I’ll do '''likewise'''.}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1971
|first=Mark
|last=Selden
|authorlink=Mark Selden
|chapter=From Land Revolution to United Front: The Shen-Kan-Ning Soviet, 1935–1936
|title=The Yenan Way in Revolutionary China
|url=https://archive.org/details/yenanwayinrevolu0000unse/
|location=Cambridge, Mass.
|publisher=w:Harvard University Press
|ISBN=0-674-96560-4
|LCCN=79-152272
|OCLC=176077
|page=69
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/yenanwayinrevolu0000unse/page/69/
|text=Chu Li-chih in late 1941 was director of the board of trade and president of the Border Region Bank in the Shen-Kan-Ning border government. Kuo Hung-t'ao served as secretary of the Shen-Kan-Ning Party Committee, the highest party post in the area, until 1938, when he was transferred to the Shansi-Chahar-Hopeh area where he '''likewise''' became secretary of the Party Committee. After Kuo's transfer, Kao Kang replaced his rival in the top party post in Shen-Kan-Ning and thereafter steadily increased his power within the border region as the leading figure among Shensi communists.}}
# {{lb|en|conjunctive}} also; moreover; too.
#: {{ux|en|Margaret enjoys playing tennis on Saturdays, Jeremy '''likewise'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Henry Hygeia at the Solito|page=179|column=1|text="But it looks like the kid ain't got no appetite to git well, for they misses him from the tent in the night and finds him rootin' in the grass, and '''likewise''' a drizzle fallin'. 'G'wan,' he says, 'lemme go and die like I wanter. He said I was a liar and a fake'—McGuire says—'and I was playin' sick. Lemme alone.'}}
# The [[same to you]]; {{non-gloss|used as a response}}.
#: {{ux|en|It was very nice meeting you, Samantha. ― '''Likewise''', Mr Thompson.}}
#: {{ux|en|‘Let me know if you need any help.’ ‘'''Likewise'''.’}}
